text:
Mia (Design): quick design note: when the compare table shrinks, badges stack and the row feels noisy. thinking about a compact stack with staggered reveal motion and an explicit "more" affordance.
Toma (Eng): motion is fine but needs prefers-reduced-motion respect. also stacking changes DOM order which might affect screen readers.
Ava (A11y): agree. if we change DOM order, ensure aria-flow-to or keep logical DOM and use CSS for visual stacking. use reduced-motion media query to disable animations. announce when row content expands via aria-live="polite".
Jordan (Product): priority is clarity on small screens and preventing accidental pins when badges overlap. what if we collapse badges into a single summary chip like "3 metrics" that opens a tray?
Mia (Design): exactly — summary chip + tray pattern. tray reveals full badges and actions (pin, details, open perf view). tray should be dismissible with Esc and focus-trapped.
Leon (Research): users in mobile tests wanted fewer taps to pin a version. many expected swipe gestures (like swipe right to pin). Nina, mobile thoughts?
Nina (Mobile): swipe can be useful but discoverability is low. recommend long-press to surface quick actions (pin, copy link) and keep a small persistent chevron to open the tray. long-press also maps well to mobile a11y since VoiceOver exposes actions.
Toma (Eng): long-press is doable. we'll need to debounce and avoid interfering with native scroll. on web, long-press can be emulated with pointerdown + timeout.
Ava (A11y): for long-press alternatives, ensure actions are reachable by keyboard and via context menu (right-click). add aria-keyshortcuts where sensible and provide visible hint: "Hold to reveal actions" for mobile.
Mia (Design): motion idea: subtle y-translate + fade for badges in tray (200ms). on reduced-motion, just show without animation. tray anchored to row, max-height with overflow-y auto.
Toma (Eng): sample CSS we can prototype: ```@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .tray { transition: transform 200ms ease, opacity 200ms; transform-origin: top left; } } .badge-stack { display:flex; gap:8px; }```
Jordan (Product): also need empty/filter mismatch state: when filters return 0 models, surface suggestions and a quick "Reset filters" CTA. users currently get a blank table. that confuses non-technical folks.
Leon (Research): in tests blank table causes abandonment. proposed copy: "No models found. Try widening filters or try presets: low-latency, quantized." include link to saved presets.
Mia (Design): empty state art: small illustration + two CTAs: Reset filters and Show presets. also add a subtle microcopy explaining why filters returned no results.
Ava (A11y): make sure empty state is focusable and announced on load with role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen reader users know the table is empty.
Toma (Eng): backend note: add an endpoint hint that returns suggested presets based on filter mismatch (server can compute nearest matches). small work but improves UX.
Jordan (Product): telemetry: badge_tray_opened, longpress_action, swipe_pin_attempt, empty_state_shown, reset_filters_clicked. Nina, track mobile gestures separately.
Nina (Mobile): will add mobile_gesture_pin in analytics and guard gestures behind a feature flag mobile_pin_gestures.
Mia (Design): last nit: pin persistence UX. when a user pins via header or tray, show a compact persistent chip in the header with count and a dismiss X. tapping chip opens pinned list.
Ava (A11y): header chip should be aria-live polite when count changes and have aria-haspopup="dialog" if it opens a panel. label it like "Pinned versions (2)".
preview-bot: preview available at https://staging.redwood.company/review/9981 — tray + empty state behind flag catalog_tray_and_empty.
Jordan (Product): great. let's prototype tray + summary chip and empty state. Mia, upload mocks; Toma, can you spin a branch? aim for demo in 5 days. thanks! :tada:
